text: Washing the cream before churning lowers the dry matter of the buttermilk and so raises the phospholipid share.

steps.name: remove casein
steps.note: The casein is removed first, because the fat-membrane fragments are about as big as the casein particles.

steps.name: polish
steps.note: The fat that does not mix with water is stripped out by carbon dioxide under high pressure, used as a solvent, which raises the share of membrane fats.
The membrane fats, the phospholipids, are cut by 38–41 % with spray drying, in one study.
